basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old adventurous spirit based in Denver, Colorado. I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me the flexibility to chase thrills like skydiving. I'm a newbie in both Reddit and skydiving, but I'm eager to learn and grow in both arenas. In my free time, I enjoy watching indie films, exploring new coffee shops, and dabbling in TikTok for the latest trends and laughs. I'm currently single and spend most of my online time during late evenings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a creative background with a degree in Graphic Design. Recently, I've been teaching myself skydiving through online courses and practical experience. I often rely on communities and forums for advice and shared experiences.
